method: InsightFace buffalo_l (detection + recognition), CPU, det_size 640, detection threshold lowered to 0.1 to list every detection; EXIF-transposed RGB; scores and face box heights in pixels, best first (CS084: top 5 of 69).
reading: Best detection score >= 0.7 separates the two human targets (0.881, 0.885) from the robot (0.525) and the stylised fox (0.331). The scan's default 0.5 threshold keeps the robot's 0.525 detection, so the human-face rule applies its own threshold. Four pictures only.
